intro: Please download and complete the appropriate forms before your visit. Bring the completed forms to your first appointment.

items.name: Authorization Form for Oxford/Empire Plan
items.file: Authorization Form for Oxford - Empire Plan.pdf
items.description: A required authorization form for your Oxford/Empire plan.

items.name: Personal Health Record
items.description: Please provide your contact information and past medical history.

items.name: NY HIPAA Release Form
items.description: Please complete this form if you would like your medical records released to a third-party.

items.name: Facial Disability Index
items.description: If you have a facial nerve disorder, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.

items.name: TMJ Disability Index
items.description: If you have a temporomandibular joint dysfunction (TMJ) disorder, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.

items.name: Vertigo
items.description: If you are experiencing symptoms of vertigo like dizziness, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.

items.name: Balance / Gait
items.description: If you are having trouble with balancing and your gait, please complete this form to assess your difficulties during these activities.

items.name: Neck
items.description: If you are experiencing pain in the general area of your neck, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.

items.name: Back
items.description: If any of your pain is located in the back area, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.

items.name: Upper Extremity
items.description: If you are experiencing pain in your upper extremities, such as your arms, hands or shoulders, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.

items.name: Lower Extremity
items.description: If you are experiencing pain in your lower extremities, such as your hips and your legs, please complete this form to assess your difficulties with daily living.
